name: sterile alpha motif domain containing 9 like

function.text: SAMD9L encodes a SAM-domain-containing protein implicated in regulation of cellular growth and hematopoietic homeostasis. Its allele-specific effects require careful distinction from acquired clonal changes.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to SAMD9L-related spectrum and myeloid neoplasm risk (autosomal dominant); ataxia-pancytopenia syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: The gene appears in specialty educational coverage, but a disease-specific somatic driver relationship has not been assigned in this draft; expression-marker or assay-context mentions are not mutation evidence.
